title: Life
wikitext:
[[Image:Life Orb.png|thumb|upright|The Player's Life Orb at full life]]

'''Life''' (also called Health or Hit Points) is the health resource of a [[character]] or [[monster]]. For the player it is shown as a red orb in the lower left of the screen. Entities [[death|die]] when they reach 0 life and must resurrect in a [[town]], [[hideout]], or [[waypoint]]. Players can both [[loss|lose]] and [[recovery|recover]] life in various ways, such as paying life [[cost]]s of skills, taking [[damage]], using [[flask]]s, [[regeneration]], [[leech]], among many other mechanics. Life is fully restored upon entering a [[town]] or [[hideout]] (except in [[Ruthless mode]], which requires you to interact with certain NPCs). 

__TOC__
==Mechanics==
Every [[Character Classes|class]] starts out with 50 life and has the following stats:
{{#cargo_query:
|tables = generic_stats
|fields = stat_text
|where = name="Character" AND id LIKE "%life%" AND value > 0
|format=ul
}}

Every 2 strength grants an additional 1 maximum life.

[[Full Life]] requires current life to be equal to maximum life. Life [[reservation]] typically prevents being on full life. 

[[Low Life]] requires life to be less or equal to 50% of the maximum. 

Effects that require life to be ''spent'' require paying life [[cost]]s. Sacrificing (e.g. {{il|Dark Bargain}}), [[reservation]], [[self-damage]] (e.g. {{il|Forbidden Rite}} or {{il|Righteous Fire}}), or generic loss (e.g. {{il|The Burden of Shadows}}) do not count as ''spending'' life. 

[[Light radius]] is based on current life.

==Calculation==
Total maximum life can be calculated with the following formula: 

{{math|formula=
\begin{align}
\text{Life}_{\text{total} } = & \left(38 + \text{Level}_{\text{Character} } \times \text{Life per level} + \frac{\text{Strength} }{2} + \sum_{i=1}^{a} \text{added Life} \right) \times \\
& \left( 1 + \sum_{j=1}^{b} \text{increased Life}_{j} - \sum_{k=1}^{c} \text{reduced Life}_{k} \right) \times \\
& \prod_{l=1}^{d} (1 + \text{more Life}_{l}) \times \prod_{m=1}^{e} (1 - \text{less Life}_{m})
\end{align}
}}

Flat life bonuses are added directly to base life ({{c|mod|+x to maximum Life}}). Percent-based modifiers apply to flat life bonuses, as well as base life and life from strength ({{c|mod|+x% increased maximum Life}}). See [[modifiers]].

More life multipliers like those found on {{il|Dissolution of the Flesh}} or [[Life Mastery]] are applied last.

===Life cap===
The highest possible maximum life value (or life cap) is 2,147,483,647 or 2<sup>31</sup> - 1; this number is typically only reached by monsters through "infinite" scaling mechanics like deep [[Delve]]. [[Ailment]] threshold can still continue to increase after hitting the life cap.

Maximum life cannot be reduced below 1. For example, equipping rings and amulets which have been [[Reflecting Mist (disambiguation)|reflected]] to have negative life values cannot place the character below a life total of 1.

==Effects based on life==
The below lists cover skill and support gems that grant life [[recovery]], have an effect based on the player's life, or inflict life-related [[debuff]]s on enemies. Lists do not include [[explosion]] effects based on enemy life, buffs or mechanics that take damage before life (e.g. {{il|Steelskin}}), or gems with [[minion]] life multipliers. 

===Active Gems===
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables=skill_gems
|join=items._pageID=skill_gems._pageID
|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
AND (items.stat_text LIKE "%of_maximum_life%" 
OR items.stat_text LIKE "%your_maximum_life%" 
OR items.stat_text LIKE "%current_life%" 
OR items.stat_text LIKE "%your_life%"
OR items.stat_text LIKE "%life_per_second%"
OR items.stat_text LIKE "%life_regen%")
AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%before_your_life%"
}}

{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables=skill_gems
|join=items._pageID=skill_gems._pageID
|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem"

===Miscellaneous===
* {{il|Runegraft of the Witchmark}} grants added chaos damage and life cost to spells based on maximum life.

==Life loss==
Life may be lost in various ways:
* Taking damage 
* [[Reservation]], e.g. with {{il|Arrogance Support}} 
* Skill [[cost]]s, naturally (e.g. {{il|Reap}}) or through e.g. {{psl|Blood Magic}} or {{il|Lifetap Support}} 
** Some mechanics can add a life cost to skills, such as {{il|Petrified Blood}}, {{il|The Covenant}}, or {{il|Runegraft of the Witchmark}} 
** Life costs are only affected by generic or life-specific cost multipliers, such as on [[support gem]]s.
* Miscellaneous loss, such as sacrificing {{il|Sacrifice Support}}, delayed loss from {{il|Progenesis}}, or [[tinctures]]' [[Weeping Wounds]] 

==Life recovery==
After life loss, Life may be recovered in various ways:
* [[Life Flask|Life]] and [[Hybrid Flasks]]
* [[Life Regeneration]]
* [[Life Leech]]
* [[Life Gain on Hit]]
* [[Life Gain on Kill]]
* [[Life Gained on Block]]
* {{il|Temporal Rift}}
* [[Portal|Returning]] to [[town]] or the [[hideout]]
* Uncategorized recovery, typically from uniques, like {{il|Defiance of Destiny}} or {{il|Bloodnotch}}

==Life transforming jewels==
These [[list of unique jewels|unique jewels]] transform life from passive skills into another base statistic.
* {{il|Energy From Within}} has the mod {{Ml|LifeInRadiusBecomesEnergyShieldAtHalfValueUniqueJewel51|display=stat_text}}
* {{il|Healthy Mind}} has the mod {{Ml|LifePassivesBecomeManaPassivesInRadiusUniqueJewel54|display=stat_text}}

===Unique Items===

Certain {{c|unique|unique}} items also grant {{c|mod|+x to maximum Life}} in exceptional quantities or on [[weapons]].

==Life on equipment for minions==
===Modifiers===
====Regular====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|tables=spawn_weights
|join=mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|where=
    mod_stats.id LIKE "%minion_maximum_life%"
    AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%elder%"
AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%shaper%"
AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%adjudicator%"
AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%crusader%"
AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%basilisk%"
AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%eyrie%"
AND mods.domain NOT IN ( "16", "28")
AND mods.generation_type NOT IN ( "24", "25", "28", "29")
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%JewelImplicit%"
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
}}

Note that these modifiers have specific basetype restrictions: 
* abyss_jewel_summoner = {{il|Ghastly Eye Jewel}} ; 
* not_int = "classic" jewels other than {{il|Cobalt Jewel|Cobalt}} and {{il|Prismatic Jewel}}; 
* x_can_roll_minion_modifiers = {{il|Convoking Wand}}, {{il|Fossilised Spirit Shield}} or its lower tier versions, and {{il|Bone Ring}}.

====Other modifiers====
*[[Crafting Bench]] has craftable suffixes for [[helmets]] that grants {{c|craft|Minions have X% increased maximum Life}}; in the permanent leagues there may have items that have [[Catarina, Master of the Dead]]-exclusive crafted prefix mod on gloves that grants {{c|craft|Minions have (10-15)% increased maximum Life}}. Catarina was retired as a master in [[version 3.5.0]] as well as some of her mods.

*In addition, [[Essences of Fear]] grant {{c|mod|Minions have X% increased maximum Life}} to the following base items up to a certain value:

** [[Body armour]], [[boots]], [[shields]] and [[belts]] ({{c|mod|Minions have (13-30)% increased maximum Life}})
** The Essences of Fear mod may able to find in other armour pieces in the items from the permanent leagues, as legacy mods. GGG changed the mod pool of the Essences of Fear in [[version 3.16.0]]

* {{ml|DelveArmourMinionLife1|display=verbose}} was used to be able to spawn on item by using [[fossil]]. However, such function was removed in [[version 3.10.0]]

* {{ml|JewelImplicitMinionLife___|display=stat_text}} can be crafted on jewel ("classic" jewel, abyss jewel, cluster jewel, timeless jewel) as an implicit, using the [[harvest crafting]] recipe granted from [[Vivid Parasite]]
